abstract: Lightcast reports that AI-related job postings in the United States have grown 50% over the past year, with AI skills now appearing in 2.5% of all job postings. This analysis examines the expanding integration of artificial intelligence across the labor market.

AI skills now appear in 2.5% of all job postings
